items.name: lifecycle-diagram
items.title: Lifecycle Diagram
items.description: Theme-aware, read-only lifecycle diagram using React Flow and ELK. Shows the current state, actual execution history, available transitions and optional end markers, with clickable state/transition details.
items.docs: Pass description.description from useLifecycle/createLifecycleHook, currentState from view.record, availableTransitions filtered from view.available, and history from view.history.transitions. History matches the exact transition/source/destination; current state alone never implies a visited path. Defaults to presentation="process" with direction DOWN, autoHeight and initialMinZoom 0.1: boundary pills and approval/work cards draw forward paths while backward and self-transitions (withdrawals, returns, retries) stay off the canvas and appear in hover/focus transition notes beside each endpoint with dashed peer outlines. Declare states in forward business progression order and pass stateKind(state) for approval, work, negative and exception visual semantics (stateKind never changes topology). For processes where many stages share early-termination final states (such as rejected, voided, or cancelled), pass explicit exitStates (state names or predicate; final states only) to keep their fan-in wires off the canvas and list those exits in each source node's hover/focus transition notes (retaining onStateClick and configuration/stateActions controls when bound). In execution views, a record stopped in a folded exit renders the terminal outcome directly on the source node identified by history; without history identifying a canvas source, that active exit state stays on the canvas highlighted as current. Omit exitStates for normal success outcomes and single-source decision branches. Pass presentation="classic" (initialMinZoom 0.7) only when every return wire must be drawn on the canvas; an explicit initialMinZoom overrides either default, and the Fit control still shows the entire graph. Override direction and autoHeight explicitly for compact canvases. Pass a translated endLabel for separate decorative markers on explicit final states. stateActions supplies explicit configuration buttons; nodeDescription displays real policy summaries. Translate ariaLabel, stateLabel and transitionLabel; append a gear to automatic transition labels if needed. Edges are solid with inline labels and subdued neutral strokes; current/visited/available highlights use the application primary theme token. onStateClick/onTransitionClick open details and never fire transitions. Keep toMermaid for documentation/export. Pass configuration={label, canConfigure, onConfigure} for automatic Configure buttons on authorized bound states and configuration selection on bound transitions. onConfigure receives the exact target and permitted bound fields grouped by native parameter key; connect the existing real editor and API. canConfigure is required and is only a UI affordance. Explicit direction/style overrides are reserved for user-requested customization; Mermaid is documentation/export only.

items.name: workflow-management
items.title: Workflow Management
items.description: Workflow administration as presentational parts: one management page with Definitions and Executions tabs, a categorized definition list, a filtered execution list, definition diagram and parameter layout, and execution history inspection beside a diagram. Wire it to application-owned routes, data and permissions.
items.docs: Install @nocobase/workflow-management and read @nocobase/workflow-management-demo. Render WorkflowManagementLayout around the application Outlet with URL-controlled Definitions and Executions tabs; declare sidebar navigation only on the Workflow management parent. Pass adapted rows, translated labels, search/category controls, status/empty content and callbacks to WorkflowDefinitionList and WorkflowExecutionList. WorkflowDefinitionDetail places the diagram beside an application-owned parameter form. WorkflowExecutionDetail takes transition/effect records and a renderDiagram callback receiving the selected history prefix and current state; render with @nocobase/lifecycle-diagram (which defaults to presentation="process", keeping backward/self-transition wires off the canvas as endpoint hover/focus notes; pass stateKind for approval/work/outcome semantics) or an existing compatible diagram. It never executes transitions or saves configuration. Keep API fetching, URL query state, permissions, parameter persistence, recovery actions and breadcrumbs in the application. All wording comes from props; no example plugin or backend is installed. Lifecycle diagrams are preinstalled in current app templates. Omit parameters to give a node-configured diagram full width, and open the same editor from LifecycleDiagram.configuration; supplying parameters retains the existing two-column layout. WorkflowVersionSelect displays translated version options as a category-style tag by default, or a field with appearance="field"; the host owns the selected version and reloads its definition and parameters.
